queries: WITH per_event AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event) SELECT link_to_event, avg_spent, avg_remaining, avg_remaining - (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM per_event) AS diff_from_mean FROM per_event ORDER BY diff_from_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH per_event AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event) SELECT link_to_event, avg_spent, avg_remaining, avg_remaining - (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM per_event) AS diff_from_mean FROM per_event ORDER BY diff_from_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Events with a NULL link_to_event are grouped together as one group and kept in the output, since the request groups by budget.link_to_event without excluding missing values.
The mean of per-event average remaining values ignores events whose average remaining is NULL (all remaining values missing), and those events get a NULL difference and sort last.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude budget rows with no event (NULL link_to_event) from the output and from the overall mean.
alternatives.sql: WITH per_event AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event) SELECT link_to_event, avg_spent, avg_remaining, avg_remaining - (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM per_event) AS diff_from_mean FROM per_event ORDER BY diff_from_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Events with a NULL link_to_event are grouped together as one group (a NULL group) rather than excluded; the request says to group by budget.link_to_event and does not say to drop them.
The mean of per-event average remaining values ignores events whose average remaining is NULL (all remaining values missing), and those events get a NULL difference and sort last.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude budget rows with no event (NULL link_to_event) so only real events are listed and used in the overall mean.
alternatives.sql: WITH per_event AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event) SELECT link_to_event, avg_spent, avg_remaining, avg_remaining - (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM per_event) AS diff_from_mean FROM per_event ORDER BY diff_from_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Events with a NULL link_to_event form one group (budget lines with no event) and are kept as a row; the mean of per-event averages ignores events whose average remaining is NULL.
Only events appearing in budget are included (no event-table join), as the request groups by budget.link_to_event.
